summary: This Form 8-K filed by GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. reports on its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders (Item 5.07), including the election of directors, advisory vote on executive compensation, and ratification of auditor. Item 8.01 discloses the appointment of Rodney F. Hochman as independent lead director and Anne T. Madden as Nominating and Governance Committee chairperson. No special-situation transaction is announced; the filing is a routine current report on standard governance matters. There are no deal terms, no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or strategic review. The document does not warrant a special-situation classification.
